result.summary: VERIFY_ONLY audit of Free vs Paid edition semantics and first-run selection. Editions are exactly desktop_bridge_free | api_paid (transport only). Free Desktop Bridge and Paid Gateway adapter share identical Snapshot/Decision contract semantics (same schemas, shared builder/import-guard, uses_same_agm_contracts=true). Paid path holds no client secrets and no provider SDK (uses_network=false, holds_provider_secrets=false, settings FORBIDDEN_SECRET_KEYS refuse storage). First-run edition_select persists choice without prior-consent; subsequent edition changes require explicit consent. Integrated headless boot is clean with fixed-angle 2.5D camera. Executable smokes: G2-007_GODOT_SMOKE=PASS, integrated --quit-after 4 EXIT=0, G5_PAID_ADAPTER_SMOKE=PASS (14 checks).
